plain.li: [mage] {OTHER_nameDef} and I drew the last fight in the dirt. I gathered too slowly on the left flank. Next time I won't.
[fighter] {OTHER_nameDef} explained how long a working takes. I'll hold the line a breath longer next time.
[mage] Argued with {OTHER_nameDef} about how our schools gather power. Neither of us gave an inch, and it was the best hour of my week.
[fighter] {OTHER_nameDef} showed me a breathing trick for long fights. I feel foolish doing it, and less tired.
Talked shop with {OTHER_nameDef} until the candle went out.
[afterraid] Went over the raid with {OTHER_nameDef}, step by step, while it was still fresh.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I worked out a signal for when one of us needs cover. Two taps on the shoulder.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has it wrong about the flank. Told {OTHER_objective} so.

cheerful.li: [mage] {OTHER_nameDef} and I are going to make a terrible, wonderful team.

gloomy.li: We planned the next fight with {OTHER_nameDef} as if there will always be a next one.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s method has two weaknesses. Mine has one. Useful conversation.

plain.li: [!mage] {OTHER_nameDef} showed me a light no bigger than a coin, cupped between {OTHER_possessive} hands. I keep looking at my own hands now.
[!mage] Asked {OTHER_nameDef} what magic feels like. I didn't understand the answer, and I liked it anyway.
[mage] {OTHER_nameDef} asked me what the gift feels like. I tried to explain and couldn't. I've never had to put it in words before.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} made a tiny light dance on {OTHER_possessive} finger for me! I want to learn.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} uses the gift for small kind things, like lighting the stove for whoever's up first.

blunt.li: Magic. Still don't trust it. That was nice, though.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} can do wonders. I can mend fences. Good for {OTHER_objective}.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s gift is more useful than I thought. Worth knowing.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} put a hand on my bad shoulder and the ache just went. I don't know how, and I don't need to.
[old] {OTHER_nameDef} eased my knees with a touch. First morning in a year I've gotten out of bed without groaning.
The old scar stopped itching after {OTHER_nameDef} looked at it. It had itched since the year it happened.
[work:Mining] {OTHER_nameDef} took the ache out of my back after a day in the mine. I could have wept.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} noticed I was hurting before I'd said a word, and came over without being asked.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} fixed my knee. Didn't ask. Good.

cheerful.li: The ache's gone! {OTHER_nameDef} is a marvel.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} eased the pain. It'll be back, but I had a good day without it.

cold.li: Had an ache taken away with a touch. Cheaper than a day in bed, and quicker.

plain.li: A traveling mage, {X_nameDef}, stopped with us today and showed me a working. I'm still thinking about it.
[mage] Met {X_nameDef}, a mage of another school. We swapped workings like recipes, and the ones from {X_possessive} school are strange.
[!mage] {X_nameDef} has the gift. I asked a hundred questions and {X_pronoun} answered most of them.
[fighter] {X_nameDef} fights for a living and moves like water. I copied {X_possessive} footwork until dark.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was generous with what {X_pronoun} knows. I hope the road is kind to {X_objective}.

blunt.li: Traveling mage. Showed off a bit. Fine.

cheerful.li: A real traveling mage! I'm going to be telling this one for years.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} walks the roads alone with all that power. I wonder what {X_pronoun}'s running from.

cold.li: {X_nameDef}'s school does things we don't. Noted.
